messages.subject: Re: Friday 5-a-side — are we one short?
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Tom,

Are we still on for 5-a-side on Friday? Liam dropped out so we might be one short — can you ask around the office? Pitch is booked 6:30.

Cheers,
Hannah

(Apologies if this has reached the wrong James — meant for James in our Manchester office.)
